criteria.name: Neural Network Design & Implementation
criteria.guidance: Build an appropriate neural-network regression model with sensible architecture and reproducible training.

criteria.name: Data Preparation & Training
criteria.guidance: Prepare features correctly, fit preprocessing on training data only, and use validation/early stopping or regularization.

criteria.name: Model Evaluation & Overfitting Analysis
criteria.guidance: Evaluate on held-out data, compare train/validation behaviour, and diagnose overfitting.

criteria.name: ML vs DL Comparison
criteria.guidance: Compare neural network and best ML baseline on the same holdout and consistent metrics.

criteria.name: NLP Implementation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Use Customer_Reviews text for a clearly defined text task; describe preprocessing and provide valid evaluation or qualitative evidence.
